headline: iOS 17 ditches Notification Center on iPhone and iPad
details: The iPhone and iPad have had Notification Center since iOS 5 in 2011. This feature provided a central place to find alerts. iOS 17 appears to have discontinued it.
The change breaks 15 years of muscle memory for users. No official statement from Apple on why this was removed.
Users are adapting to the new interface.
caption:
15 years of muscle memory broken?

The iPhone and iPad have had Notification Center since iOS 5 in 2011. This feature provided a central place to find alerts. iOS 17 appears to have discontinued it.

The change breaks 15 years of muscle memory for users. No official statement from Apple on why this was removed.

Users are adapting to the new interface.
